rule: An OpenAlex author id is a PI's when (a) it carries the PI's ORCID, or (b) its school works (hierarchy/michigan/oa-author-stats.json.gz, papers only) are under the PI's full name, at the University of Michigan, in years the department listing names the PI, in venues of the PI's listed field, and no other id at the school carries that name with another field. Namesakes seen and set aside are listed. Evidence: one sweep work per id, quoting the authorship's raw name and raw affiliation string (tools/oa_identity_school.py).
